# Getting help

This is a reference deployment, not a managed product, but questions are welcome.

**For a question about this stack** — how a default was chosen, whether it fits your host,
what changes for your workflows — open an issue on this repository. Keeping the question
next to the configuration it is about is more useful to everyone than a private thread.

**For a security issue in this reference**, do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's private
security advisory feature on this repository. [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) has the detail.

**To talk about an engagement** — an audit of an existing deployment, a hardening pass, or a
migration of live automations onto a hardened stack — email **jarr.wright@gmail.com**. Tell
me what you are running and what is breaking.

*If you found me through a freelancing platform, please keep the conversation
there until a contract is in place.*
